rater_1_rationale: Flags NetworkPolicies that do not select any pods, an unused resource rather than a security or availability issue (kube-linter v0.8.3).
rater_2_rationale: A NetworkPolicy without matching workloads may indicate stale configuration.

rater_1_rationale: Flags NetworkPolicy peer selectors that match no pods, flagging unused ingress/egress rules (kube-linter v0.8.3).
rater_2_rationale: A peer pod selector matching no Pods may indicate stale policy configuration.

rater_1_rationale: Flags Services that do not match any pods, indicating an unused or misconfigured service (kube-linter v0.8.3).
rater_2_rationale: A Service without matching Pods is likely an ineffective configuration.

rater_1_rationale: Flags ServiceMonitors that do not match any services, an unused monitoring configuration (kube-linter v0.8.3).
rater_2_rationale: A ServiceMonitor without a matching Service is likely ineffective.

rater_1_rationale: Flags deployments without dnsConfig, a DNS-configuration preference (kube-linter v0.8.3).
rater_2_rationale: DNS configuration options concern workload configuration correctness.

rater_1_rationale: Flags NodePort and LoadBalancer services, which expose pods on external interfaces (kube-linter v0.8.3).
rater_2_rationale: Exposed Services can broaden external access to workloads.

rater_1_rationale: Flags containers without liveness probes, so hung processes are not restarted (kube-linter v0.8.3).
rater_2_rationale: Missing liveness probes weaken workload health management.

rater_1_rationale: Flags containers without readiness probes, so traffic may reach unready pods (kube-linter v0.8.3).
rater_2_rationale: Missing readiness probes impair service readiness management.

rater_1_rationale: Flags deployments not using rolling updates, risking downtime during updates (kube-linter v0.8.3).
rater_2_rationale: Deployment update strategy affects safe rollout behavior.

rater_1_rationale: Flags PodDisruptionBudgets without unhealthyPodEvictionPolicy set, affecting eviction behavior (kube-linter v0.8.3).
rater_2_rationale: Eviction policy governs operational disruption behavior.

rater_1_rationale: Flags objects without an owner email annotation, an organizational metadata requirement (kube-linter v0.8.3).
rater_2_rationale: Required ownership annotations concern configuration metadata quality.

rater_1_rationale: Flags objects without an owner label, an organizational metadata requirement (kube-linter v0.8.3).
rater_2_rationale: Owner labels support configuration accountability and maintenance.

rater_1_rationale: Flags deployment-like objects without restart policy set to Always or OnFailure (kube-linter v0.8.3).
rater_2_rationale: Restart policy concerns workload execution configuration.

rater_1_rationale: Flags YAML keys not in alphabetical order, a style and consistency preference (kube-linter v0.8.3).
rater_2_rationale: Consistent key ordering concerns manifest maintainability.

rater_1_rationale: Requires CronJob deadline configuration, governing job execution behavior (kube-score v1.20.0).
rater_2_rationale: CronJob deadlines govern scheduled job execution behavior.

rater_1_rationale: Requires valid CronJob RestartPolicy, controlling pod restart on failure (kube-score v1.20.0).
rater_2_rationale: CronJob restart policy concerns job configuration correctness.

rater_1_rationale: Requires RollingUpdate strategy for service-targeted deployments, avoiding downtime (kube-score v1.20.0).
Requires safe pod probe configurations, a runtime-reliability control (kube-score v1.20.0).
rater_2_rationale: Health probes support workload operational correctness.

rater_1_rationale: Requires readiness and liveness probes to differ, avoiding mismatched probe behavior (kube-score v1.20.0).
rater_2_rationale: Identical probes can indicate poorly differentiated health checks.
